**Exercise - Using functions**

Round the number 3.14159 to the nearest whole number
```{r}
round(3.14159)
```
The result I obtained is 3.

**Exercise - Argument order**

Specify arguments in order:
```{r}
print(rep(5,7))
```
Using their names:
```{r}
print(rep(x=5,times=7))
```

**Exercise - Assigning values to variables**

**Exercise - Using variables of different types**

```{r}
Radiation_ID<-"CX1"
Control_ID<-"CX2"
Radiation_treated<-TRUE
Control_treated<-FALSE
Radiation_num_cells_before<-5415
Control_num_cells_before<-8123
Radiation_num_cells_after<-1432
Control_num_cells_after<-7543
```

**Excercise - Vectors**
```{r}
Radiation_ID<-"CX1"
Control_ID<-"CX2"
Radiation_treated<-TRUE
Control_treated<-FALSE
Radiation_num_cells_before<-5415
Control_num_cells_before<-8123
Radiation_num_cells_after<-1432
Control_num_cells_after<-7543

ID<-c(Radiation_ID,Control_ID)
treatment<-c(Radiation_treated,Control_treated)
num_before<-c(Radiation_num_cells_before,Control_num_cells_before)
num_after<-c(Radiation_num_cells_after,Control_num_cells_after)

print(ID)
print(treatment)
print(num_before)
print(num_after)
```
**Exercise - Indexing**

```{r}
all_my_pets<-c("dogs","horse","guinea pig","chicken","cat")
fourth_pet<-all_my_pets[4]
print(fourth_pet)
```

**Exercise - Creating a data frame**

```{r}
result_table<-tibble(
  cell_id=ID,
  treated=treatment,
  num_cells_before=num_before,
  num_cells_after=num_after
)
gt(result_table)
```
